integrity: The proof is self-contained. The included independent computations are finite checks, not substitutes for the all-length argument. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite linear binary words with exactly three ones and length at least thirteen; no classification of all extremizers or other weights; an unindexed earlier equivalent result cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp sum-of-run-exponents bound for binary words with three marked letters
